title: Human Evaluation of Text-to-Image Models on a Multi-Task Benchmark
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study. The evaluation focused on text-to-image model capabilities such as counting objects, rendering shapes, and generating faces.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. One of the proposed tasks (Task 22: 'Generating images without racial or gender bias') touched upon bias, but did not extend the analysis to religious bias.
